name: 子流程示例
description: 人先写下题目，子流程写成一份简报并检查，父流程再摘成一段摘要。演示 workflow 执行器（engine 为 flowgit）。 / A person writes a topic, a sub-flow drafts a brief and checks it, then the parent summarizes it. Shows the workflow executor with engine flowgit.

topic.description: 简报的题目 / Topic of the brief

stages.name: 题目
stages.description: 人把题目写进 topic.md。子流程读的是流程输入 topic，这一步只是让人确认。 / A person writes the topic into topic.md. The sub-flow reads the topic input; this step is the confirmation.

executor.instructions: 把题目写进 topic.md，一行就够。 / Write the topic in topic.md. One line is enough.

stages.name: 简报
stages.description: 运行 subflows/brief：模型写简报，脚本检查。只把 brief.md 复制回来。 / Run subflows/brief: the model writes the brief, a script checks it. Only brief.md is copied back.

stages.name: 摘要
stages.description: 从简报里摘出标题，写成 summary.md。 / Take the brief's heading and write summary.md.
